remarks: Open the door and immediately experience the sights and sounds of the creek flowing behind this well maintained three/four-bedroom home. Set on a unique lot with mature landscaping & a wooded backdrop, this property offers a rare combination of comfort, updates, versatile spaces, and peaceful outdoor living. The newly updated kitchen is both stylish and exceptionally functional, featuring stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, luxury vinyl flooring, and well-planned cabinetry with a pantry, deep drawers, lazy Susans, and cooking-sheet racks,& a door to the spacious screened enclosure, where you can enjoy the tranquil wooded setting and the soothing sounds of the creek. Step outside onto the large open deck for an expansive view of the creek or relax on the covered front porch. Inside, the sunlit living room features large windows and a beautiful new stone gas fireplace with gas insert, creating a warm and inviting gathering space. Addn'l flexible rooms can easily serve as a formal dining room, home office, den, or what best suits your lifestyle. A newly updated common bath provides modern convenience for family and guests, while the first-floor laundry/pantry keeps everyday essentials conveniently located on one level. The spacious primary bedroom is a true retreat, complete with a slider leading to the screened enclosure, an ensuite bath with newer shower, vanity, flooring, walk-in cedar closet, and room for a comfortable sitting area. Upstairs, you'll find two additional bedrooms plus a versatile space with potential to create a third bedroom. The property continues to impress with a detached garage connected to the home by a concrete walkway, a full basement with an overhead door, providing storage and excellent space for hobbies, projects, or a workshop. Recently installed heating system and tankless hot water. A whole-home backup generator provides added peace of mind during power outages. From the mature landscaping and private wooded setting to the creekside views and extensive updates, this is a home designed for both everyday living and relaxing. Come experience the sights, sounds, and unique character of this special property.
